subject: Request: security testing artifacts and upload to Blue Harbor GRC portal
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@blueharbor.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinfra.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinfra.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security testing artifacts and upload to Blue Harbor GRC portal

Hi Kimberly / Jonas,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the questionnaire. Blue Harbor's procurement team needs the associated security testing artifacts to complete our SIG/CAIQ validation and SOC 2 evidence intake. Specifically we require:

- The final penetration test report (redacted version is acceptable)
- An evidence index mapping test findings to supporting artifacts (screenshots, logs, remediation tickets)
- Confirmation of which findings were re-tested and their remediation verification date
- A statement on retention/PII redaction (what will be removed from the shared report)

We prefer artifacts uploaded to our secure GRC portal (link below) rather than email attachments. If you must send files, please indicate the filenames and a short description in your reply.

Portal upload link: https://grc.blueharbor.com/upload/ABC123

Do you have an estimated delivery timeline? We are targeting intake this week to avoid delaying our contract review. Also, if you need a signed DPA or additional access agreement before upload, flag that now.

Best,
Elena Costa
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst | Blue Harbor Health
Elena.Costa@blueharbor.com

Attachments referenced: None (requesting upload to portal)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinfra.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@blueharbor.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinfra.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: security testing artifacts and upload to Blue Harbor GRC portal

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a redacted pen test report plus an evidence index and remediation verification notes. Quick notes and ask on scope:

- Redaction: we will remove internal IP addresses, tester PII, and any exploit PoC that contains client-specific secrets. We will retain CVE identifiers and technical descriptions of findings. Let us know if you need additional redactions.
- Evidence index: we will produce a CSV mapping each finding ID to artifact filenames (screenshots, ticket links, logs where permissible).
- Remediation verification: for medium/high findings we will note re-test dates and ticket IDs; for informational items we will flag as N/A.
- Portal: we can upload directly to the URL you provided. Please confirm whether your intake process requires a specific filename convention or an upload metadata field for 'report version' and 'scan snapshot date'.

Timeline: our security team can prepare and upload the redacted package by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-02). If you need it sooner, we can prioritize individual items (summary + index) by Monday 2026-11-01 morning.

We will not include raw packet captures or full debug logs unless there's a signed DPA / evidence transfer agreement. If you need those, please send the DPA link and we'll escalate.

Planned attachments for upload: redacted-pen-test-summary-20261030.pdf, evidence-index-20261030.csv

Let me know the preferred filename format and whether we should include a CSV column for your internal reference number.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Security Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinfra.com

Attachments (to be uploaded to portal): evidence-index-20261030.csv (CSV mapping findings -> artifacts)

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@blueharbor.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinfra.com>
Cc: Blue Harbor Health GRC <grc@blueharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: security testing artifacts and upload to Blue Harbor GRC portal

Thanks, Kimberly — that plan works. A few clarifications:

- Filename convention: please use HBH_Report_[vendor]_[YYYYMMDD]_redacted.pdf and HBH_EvidenceIndex_[vendor]_[YYYYMMDD].csv (so for you: HBH_Report_Redwood_20261030_redacted.pdf).
- Metadata: our intake form asks for 'report version', 'scan snapshot date', and 'engineer contact' — if you can populate those during upload that will speed review.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA but it isn't required for redacted artifacts. We will request additional artifacts (raw logs) only if the initial review needs them and then we'll route a DPA/secure transfer.
- Re-test sampling: can you include at least one verification screenshot or ticket thread per high/critical finding so we can confirm remediation?

Timeline: we appreciate the Tuesday target but a Monday morning partial upload (summary + index + at least one verification sample for critical findings) would be ideal. Please upload to https://grc.blueharbor.com/upload/ABC123 and confirm once done.

Best,
Elena

Blue Harbor GRC intake: grc@blueharbor.com
Portal: https://grc.blueharbor.com/upload/ABC123

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinfra.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinfra.com>, Elena Costa <elena.costa@blueharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: security testing artifacts and upload to Blue Harbor GRC portal

Elena / Kimberly —

Ack. Kimberly, I'll take the lead on curating the verification samples and preparing the HBH filename convention. Plan:

1) Finalize redaction pass this afternoon.
2) Export report to HBH_Report_Redwood_20261030_redacted.pdf.
3) Produce evidence-index CSV and include a column with one verification artifact per high/critical finding (ticket link or screenshot).
4) Upload partial package (report + index + 1 sample per critical finding) to the GRC portal by Mon 2026-11-02 18:00 PT.

Elena — once uploaded I'll reply with the portal upload confirmation and a short manifest (filenames + short descriptions). If you need anything else faster ping me directly.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinfra.com

Uploaded attachments (to portal): HBH_Report_Redwood_20261030_redacted.pdf, HBH_EvidenceIndex_Redwood_20261030.csv
